metadata.name: San Antonio Emergency Public Info (Dormant Layer)
metadata.description: Resilience hubs and official emergency resources. NOT on the day-to-day map. Tucked for function testing and rapid deployment during wet/flood/severe weather events. When activated, surface immediately and push Ready South Texas app link.
metadata.activation: Set window.CHICA_EMERGENCY_DEPLOY = true or URL ?emergency=1 to enable toggle and layer. On real need: flip flag, push live, promote Ready South Texas.
sources: City of San Antonio Office of Emergency Management (saoemprepare.com)
Bexar County Office of Emergency Management
metadata.note: Locations are primary resilience hubs repeatedly activated by the City for severe weather. Actual activation is event-driven and announced via official channels. Always verify current status with 311 / SAOEM / Ready South Texas.

properties.name: Copernicus Community Center
properties.hours_note: Activated as needed for severe weather (overnight resilience hub)
properties.notes: City resilience hub. Shelter, charging, Wi-Fi, basic supplies when activated. Pets often accommodated.

properties.name: Normoyle Community Center / Senior Center
properties.hours_note: Activated as needed for severe weather (overnight resilience hub)
properties.notes: City resilience hub. Frequently listed for cold/heat events. Pets often accommodated.

properties.name: Southside Lions Senior Center
properties.address: 3303 Pecan Valley Dr, San Antonio, TX 78210
properties.hours_note: Activated as needed for severe weather (overnight resilience hub)
properties.notes: City resilience hub. Shelter, charging, resources when activated.

properties.name: Gilbert Garza Community Center
properties.hours_note: Activated as needed for severe weather (overnight resilience hub)
properties.notes: City resilience hub (also called Garza Community Center). Verify current status via official channels.

properties.name: Miller's Pond Community Center

properties.hours_note: Activated as needed for severe weather (overnight resilience hub)
properties.notes: City resilience hub. Confirm activation status with 311 or SAOEM.

properties.name: Northeast Senior Center
properties.hours_note: Activated as needed for severe weather (overnight resilience hub)
properties.notes: City resilience hub. Verify live status.

properties.name: San Antonio Office of Emergency Management
properties.notes: Primary local authority for evacuation guidance, alerts, and plans. Sign up for alerts. Not a physical shelter pin.

properties.name: Ready South Texas App
properties.address: Mobile app — evacuation maps, shelters, alerts
properties.hours_note: Download free — works offline for maps after first load
properties.notes: Official Bexar/SA preparedness app. Evacuation route maps, shelter locations, push alerts, personal plan builder. Primary link to push when this layer is deployed.

properties.name: Bexar County Office of Emergency Management
properties.notes: County-level emergency management. Sign up for Regional Emergency Alert Network (REAN).
